top_stories.title: Karnataka politics LIVE: Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah announces decision to step down at breakfast meeting with Ministers - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, Karnataka's Chief Minister, announced his resignation during a breakfast meeting at his residence on May 28th. He informed his Cabinet colleagues that he had been asked to step down by the **Congress High Command**.  He will visit the Governor’s office and address a press conference later in the day. The Congress Legislative Party is expected to meet on Friday (May 29, 2026) to discuss the likely successor.

top_stories.title: Top 4 debt mutual fund managers oversee over Rs 1 lakh crore AUM in March quarter.Check details - AUM wise | The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Ventura**, **ETMarkets.com**, and other sources report that the top four debt mutual fund managers in India manage at least Rs 1 lakh crore of assets under management (AUM) as of March 2026 quarter. **Kaustubh Gupta** of **Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Fund** leads with Rs 1.61 lakh crore AUM, followed by **Manish Banthia** of **ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund** with Rs 1.45 lakh crore AUM.  **Deepak Agrawal** of **Kotak Mutual Fund** manages Rs 1.29 lakh crore AUM and **Rajeev Radhakrishnan** of **SBI Mutual Fund** has Rs 1.14 lakh crore AUM.

top_stories.title: Iran and US trade attacks after Trump rejects report of Hormuz agreement | News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: Following US attacks near Bandar Abbas airport, the **Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC)** targeted a US base in retaliation.  An unnamed US official said the US military shot down four Iranian attack drones and struck a ground control station. The ceasefire remains fragile as negotiations to end the war drag on, with both sides expressing confidence that they are not yet ready to collapse the agreement. **Donald Trump** rejected an Iranian report of a deal restoring commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz within a month, while **Ebrahim Azizi**, head of the Iranian parliament's national security committee, stated that Iran will not back down from its demands for uranium enrichment and sanctions relief.

top_stories.title: Oil prices jump after US launches new attacks on Iran
top_stories.rephrased_article: **US** forces conducted new airstrikes on **Iran**, targeting a military site in Bandar Abbas, a strategic port city. The attacks came despite a ceasefire between the two countries and raised oil prices globally. Brent crude rose by 3.75% to $97.83 (£73.15) per barrel, while US-traded crude was 4% higher at $92.22.  The strikes have escalated tensions in the region and threaten global energy supplies.

top_stories.title: Kaja Kallas warns against walking into Russian ‘trap’ as EU ministers meet for talks – Europe live | Europe | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Kaja Kallas**, the **EU's** foreign policy chief, warned against focusing on personalities in potential peace talks with Russia and urged the bloc to prioritize substance over individuals. She cautioned against falling into a Russian trap by discussing who would lead negotiations, emphasizing that the EU must be represented regardless of the chosen negotiator.  Several EU ministers are divided on appointing a single negotiator for Russia, with some advocating for a team effort while others prefer a more neutral approach. **Péter Magyar**, Hungary's new prime minister, is in Brussels to discuss frozen EU funds, but his visit has been overshadowed by ongoing negotiations over Orbán-era reforms.

top_stories.title: Mike Marshall: Meet Mike Marshall: The former soldier graduating at 69 after leaving school with no qualifications at 15 | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Mike Marshall**, a 69-year-old former soldier and police officer, is graduating with a 2:1 in History from the **University of East Anglia**.  He left school at 15 without qualifications and pursued a career in public service before returning to education as a mature student. After an unexpected conversation with a university admissions staff member, Marshall enrolled and overcame initial challenges to achieve top grades. He plans to pursue a history-focused tour across Europe after graduation and considers further studies.  Marshall's journey exemplifies determination, lifelong learning, and second chances.

top_stories.title: Karnataka CM Siddaramaiah announces decision to step down at breakfast meeting with Ministers - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister of Karnataka, announced his resignation from the post during a breakfast meeting at his residence on May 28th. He informed his Cabinet colleagues that he had been asked to step down by the **Congress High Command**.  The decision comes after speculation about his continuation and an offer of a Rajya Sabha seat from **Rahul Gandhi**, Leader of Opposition in Rajya Sabha, who requested him to pave the way for a new leader. The Governor, **Thaawarchand Gehlot**, is expected to meet with **Siddaramaiah** before accepting his resignation.

top_stories.title: Bitcoin trades at $73K amid US-Iran tensions; ETF outflows top $2.5 billion in 2 weeks - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: The cryptocurrency market experienced a downturn, with Bitcoin falling below $74,000 and Ethereum dropping to near $1,977.  **CoinDCX Research Team** reported over $700 million in liquidations, primarily driven by geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran and concerns about institutional flows. **Vikram Subburaj**, CEO of **Giottus**, emphasized the importance of reclaiming the $80,000 mark for market stability.  **Avinash Shekhar**, Co-Founder & CEO of **Pi42**, advised investors to adopt a long-term approach and remain patient during periods of volatility.

top_stories.title: Australia charges alleged ISIL-linked woman after return from Syria | ISIL/ISIS News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Australia** has charged a 34-year-old woman with alleged links to the ISIL group after she returned from Syria. The woman faces charges of being a member of a "terrorist" organization and entering a declared conflict zone, potentially resulting in up to 10 years imprisonment. **Police** are investigating all adult returnees, including three women who face additional charges, including crimes against humanity.  The repatriation of these individuals follows the return of women and children from Syrian detention camps without trial.

top_stories.title: Google worker charged with using internal data to make $1.2m on Polymarket
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Michele Spagnuolo**, a Google engineer, has been arrested for allegedly using internal data to profit from bets on the prediction platform Polymarket.  The US Attorney for the Southern District of New York charged **Spagnuolo** with insider trading after he reportedly placed over $2.7 million in bets related to Google between October and December 2022. The FBI, working with the US Attorney's office, linked **Spagnuolo**'s accounts through an Italian identification card. **Google** said it is cooperating with law enforcement and has placed **Spagnuolo** on leave.
